items.title: EPSO Verbal — Digital Services Act
items.stem: According to the passage, the Regulation:
options: provides the legal basis for national authorities to issue orders against illegal content
harmonises minimum conditions that such orders must meet for providers' notification obligations to apply
regulates the territorial scope of national orders against illegal content
requires Member States to harmonise their substantive laws on illegal content
items.explanation: The final two sentences state the Regulation harmonises 'certain specific minimum conditions' and explicitly does NOT 'provide the legal basis for the issuing of such orders, nor does it regulate their territorial scope'.
